evidence.quote: Manually refresh a single chart to only requery the data source for that chart and render that chart with the latest data.

Charts uses the [Invoices API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/group/endpoint-invoices) to ingest the last twelve months of the specified organization's billing data into the specified deployment and database. After you create the initial ingestion, Atlas ingests billing data daily.
